title.en: Blanche defends Trump’s tirade against supreme court after it blocked mail-in voting executive order – US politics live
title.zh: 特朗普抨击阻止邮寄投票行政命令的决定：“这个法院真的让我们的国家失望了”——直播

summary.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world. The Supreme Court has rejected Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections. Kash Patel, the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee.
summary.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他本人曾多次使用邮寄投票——是全世界的“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会就此向议员们作证。

body.en: Attorney general says president ‘should communicate his concerns with the supreme court’ after Trump said justices ‘really let our country down’ Sign up for US Breaking News emails Kash Patel , the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee. A reminder that the last time he appeared before Congress was in May, when he sparred with senators on the appropriations committee and denied – under oath – allegations of excessive drinking and unexplained absences on the job, dismissing them as “baseless” during a fiery congressional hearing. Today’s hearing is also expected to be full of heated exchanges. “Mr Patel is the least qualified and most partisan FBI director in our nation’s history,” said Senator Dick Durbin, the judiciary committee’s top Democrat. “The bureau has been reshaped as a political weapon against President Trump’s political enemies and a shield to protect the president and his MAGA loyalists, not the American people.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他曾多次使用这种方式进行投票——在全世界都是“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会的议员面前作证。提醒人们，他最后一次出现在国会是在五月份，当时他与拨款委员会的参议员发生争执，并在宣誓后否认了有关过度饮酒和不明原因缺勤的指控，并在一场激烈的国会听证会上驳斥称这些指控“毫无根据”。今天的听证会预计也会充满激烈的交流。 “帕特尔先生是我们国家历史上最不合格、最具党派倾向的联邦调查局局长，”司法委员会民主党领袖、参议员迪克·杜宾(Dick Durbin)说。 “该局已被重塑为对抗特朗普总统政敌的政治武器，以及保护总统和他的 MAGA 忠诚者而不是美国人民的盾牌。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Supreme Court's rejection of mail-in voting restrictions, despite the president's strong objections, underscores the principle that legal processes often require hearing multiple perspectives. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that even in disputes, there is value in listening to each party before rendering a verdict, a principle crucial for maintaining trust...
reflection.zh: 最高法院驳回了对邮寄投票的限制，尽管总统对此表示强烈反对，这凸显了法律程序通常需要听取多方观点的原则。箴言18:17提醒我们，即使在争端中，在做出裁决之前听取各方陈述也是有价值的，这一原则对于维护机构的信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Bernie Sanders says Congress has been ‘asleep at the wheel’ over AI – video
title.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯称国会一直在“睡大觉”，对人工智能置若罔闻——视频

summary.en: Vermont senator Bernie Sanders criticized the advancement of artificial intelligence at the Pro-Human Assembly in Washington on Tuesday, warning that the current version of AI is 'the least capable version of AI that we will ever have.' He spoke alongside other AI skeptics, including Steve Bannon.
summary.zh: 佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯周二在华盛顿举行的“亲人类大会”上批评了人工智能的进步，并警告说，当前版本的人工智能是“我们所能拥有的最不强大的人工智能”。他与其他人工智能怀疑论者一起发表了讲话，其中包括史蒂夫·班农。

body.en: Bernie Sanders criticised the advancement of artificial intelligence at the Pro-Human Assembly in Washington Tuesday, warning that this version of AI is 'the least capable version of AI that we will ever have'. The independent senator from Vermont was speaking at the conference alongside a number of AI sceptics, including Steve Bannon
body.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯周二在华盛顿亲人类大会上批评了人工智能的进步，警告说这个版本的人工智能是“我们所拥有的最没有能力的人工智能版本”。这位来自佛蒙特州的独立参议员在会议上与包括史蒂夫·班农 (Steve Bannon) 在内的一些人工智能怀疑论者一起发表讲话

reflection.en: Senator Sanders' urgent warning about artificial intelligence echoes a biblical theme of rapidly increasing knowledge. As technology races ahead, we are reminded of the need for wisdom and discernment, not just raw information. May we seek understanding that serves humanity and honors our Creator.
reflection.zh: 桑德斯参议员对人工智能发出的紧急警告，呼应了圣经中知识快速增长的主题。随着科技飞速发展，我们被提醒需要智慧和辨别力，而不仅仅是原始信息。愿我们寻求服务于人类并荣耀我们创造主的理解力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Boston dumps Flock, says it shared data nationwide in violation of contract
title.zh: 波士顿因违约共享数据而放弃Flock，称其违反合同

summary.en: Boston has stopped using Flock Safety's license-plate reader cameras after the company allegedly shared data nationwide, violating a contract that required such sharing to be disabled. City officials cited a "vendor error" that led to this unauthorized data dissemination, as detailed in the city's annual surveillance...
summary.zh: 波士顿已停止使用Flock Safety的牌照识别摄像头，此前该公司据称违反合同规定，启用了全国范围的数据共享功能。市政府官员指出，这是一个“供应商错误”，导致了未经授权的数据传播，具体情况已在市政府的年度监控技术报告中披露。

body.en: The Boston city government abandoned Flock Safety's license-plate reader cameras after the company shared data nationwide in violation of a contract provision, according to city officials. "We have actually abandoned Flock," Boston Mayor Michelle Wu said in her monthly "Ask the Mayor" segment on GBH News last week. Wu made the comment a few days before the release of Boston's annual surveillance technology report , which said a Flock "vendor error" resulted in nationwide data sharing. The report, which covers 2025, describes how the Boston Police Department deployed about 45 Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) cameras in a trial with Flock from April to September last year. The unauthorized data sharing occurred during the first few days of the pilot, the report said: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据波士顿市官员称，在该公司违反合同条款在全国范围内共享数据后，波士顿市政府放弃了 Flock Safety 的车牌读取器摄像头。 “我们实际上已经放弃了 Flock，”波士顿市长 Michelle Wu 上周在 GBH News 的每月“询问市长”部分中说道。吴在波士顿年度监控技术报告发布前几天发表了上述评论，该报告称 Flock 的“供应商错误”导致了全国范围内的数据共享。该报告涵盖 2025 年，描述了去年 4 月至 9 月波士顿警察局如何在 Flock 试验中部署约 45 个自动车牌读取器 (ALPR) 摄像头。报告称，未经授权的数据共享发生在试点的最初几天： 阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: When technology companies are entrusted with sensitive data, their adherence to contractual agreements and ethical data handling is paramount. Boston's decision to abandon Flock Safety underscores the importance of accountability, reminding us that integrity in business practices is essential for maintaining public trust and upholding justice.
reflection.zh: 当科技公司被委托处理敏感数据时，它们遵守合同规定和进行合乎道德的数据处理至关重要。波士顿决定放弃Flock Safety，凸显了问责制的重要性，提醒我们商业实践中的诚信对于维持公众信任和伸张正义是必不可少的。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Demand for EV chargers is outstripping supply, says ChargePoint report
title.zh: 电动汽车充电桩的供应落后于需求

summary.en: Despite fluctuating optimism about electric vehicle (EV) adoption, the transition continues with over 1.8 million EVs sold in the US by August. However, charging infrastructure is not keeping pace with this growth, according to a ChargePoint report, with a significant uptick in US drivers considering EVs due to rising...
summary.zh: 尽管对电动汽车（EV）的采用前景的乐观情绪有所波动，但这一转型仍在继续，截至8月，美国已售出超过180万辆电动汽车。然而，根据ChargePoint的一份报告，充电基础设施的增长未能跟上这一增长的步伐，而美国由于燃料价格上涨，考虑购买电动汽车的司机人数显著增加。

body.en: There might not be the same degree of optimism regarding electric vehicle adoption as a few short years ago, but the transition toward battery-electric vehicles continues nevertheless. More than 1.8 million EVs had already been sold between the start of this year and the end of August, according to analysts. And in the US, there has been a large uptick in drivers considering EVs that they might have written off last year, due to escalating fuel prices with no clear end in sight. Despite this, charging infrastructure continues to lag, according to a new report from ChargePoint. “All in all, things are moving forward. I think the North American market has been better shaped than a lot of the press reports,” said ChargePoint CEO Rick Wilmer. “Part of it is just the data we see in terms of the amount of RFPs that we receive for charging solutions. They haven't slowed down. We reported quarter over quarter growth in the last quarter we reported. And you look at the data around used EVs going up in price because the demand is so high. I saw a recent report … EV retention rates are 96 percent. So those folks that are putting their leased cars on the used market, they're not going back to gas, they're going to another EV,” he said. Beyond that, cheap electric trucks from Slate and Ford indicate further future demand for charging. “When you look at how much interest there is in the used EVs that are at parity with an equivalent gas vehicle, that tells you the appetite is there for EVs if it's the right vehicle at the right price point," Wilmer said. "So I think the auto OEMs, maybe not homogeneously, but they're figuring out what the market wants in North America, and they're starting to introduce those vehicles, which I don't think a lot of the forward-looking forecasts accommodate the fact that the product market fit is getting better coming out of the car companies.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 人们对电动汽车的采用可能不再像几年前那样乐观，但向电池电动汽车的过渡仍在继续。据分析师称，从今年年初到 8 月底，电动汽车的销量已超过 180 万辆。在美国，由于燃油价格不断上涨而且还没有明确的结束迹象，考虑去年可能放弃的电动汽车的司机大幅增加。尽管如此，根据 ChargePoint 的一份新报告，充电基础设施仍然滞后。 ChargePoint 首席执行官 Rick Wilmer 表示：“总而言之，事情正在向前发展。我认为北美市场的状况比许多媒体报道的要好。” “部分原因是我们收到的充电解决方案征求建议书数量方面的数据。它们并没有放缓。我们在上个季度报告了季度环比增长。你会看到二手电动汽车价格上涨的数据，因为需求如此之高。我看到了最近的一份报告……电动汽车保留率为 96%。因此，那些将租赁汽车投放到二手市场的人，他们不会再使用汽油，而是会转向另一辆电动汽车，”他说。除此之外，Slate 和福特的廉价电动卡车表明未来对充电的进一步需求。威尔默说：“当你看看人们对与同等燃油汽车相当的二手电动汽车有多少兴趣时，就会告诉你，如果电动汽车是价格合适的合适车辆，那么人们对电动汽车就有兴趣。” “所以我认为汽车原始设备制造商的情况可能并不相同，但他们正在弄清楚北美市场需要什么，并且开始推出这些车辆，我认为很多前瞻性预测都没有考虑到汽车公司的产品市场契合度正在变得更好的事实。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid adoption of electric vehicles, driven by factors like rising fuel prices, presents a significant opportunity for a cleaner future. Yet, as ChargePoint's report highlights, the necessary infrastructure—charging stations—is struggling to keep pace. This situation calls for diligent planning and commitment, entrusting our efforts to God, who guides...
reflection.zh: 电动汽车的快速普及，尤其是在燃料价格上涨的背景下，为更清洁的未来带来了巨大的机遇。然而，正如ChargePoint的报告所指出的，必要的充电基础设施却难以跟上这一步伐。这种情况需要我们勤勉规划、坚定承诺，并将我们的努力交托给雅伟，祂引导我们的工作并确保其成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Louise Haigh: UK must heed warnings from AI experts
title.zh: 路易丝·海：英国必须听取人工智能专家的警告

summary.en: The First Secretary has warned of the 'huge risks' posed by artificial intelligence, urging ministers to heed warnings from industry leaders. She emphasized the need for appropriate 'guardrails' to be put in place to address potential threats to national security and society, despite AI's potential to improve lives.
summary.zh: 第一书记警告人工智能带来的“巨大风险”，敦促部长们听取行业领导者的警告。她强调需要建立适当的“护栏”来应对对国家安全和社会构成的潜在威胁，尽管人工智能有改善生活的潜力。

body.en: First secretary warns of ‘huge risks’ of technology as PM is urged to use next year’s G20 to drive global regulation Ministers must “heed the warnings” from industry leaders about the threat posed by AI, Louise Haigh has said, amid calls for Andy Burnham to use the G20 to drive global regulation. The first secretary said that while AI had enormous potential to improve lives, and the government wanted to capitalise on the technology, there were “clearly huge risks to our national security and society if the right guardrails are not put in place”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 第一秘书警告总理利用明年的 G20 峰会推动全球监管，技术存在“巨大风险”路易丝·黑格 (Louise Haigh) 表示，在呼吁安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 利用 G20 峰会推动全球监管之际，部长们必须“留意行业领袖关于人工智能构成威胁的警告”。第一秘书表示，虽然人工智能在改善生活方面具有巨大潜力，而且政府希望利用这项技术，但“如果没有采取正确的防护措施，我们的国家安全和社会显然会面临巨大风险”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, its potential for both good and harm becomes increasingly apparent. Louise Haigh's call to heed expert warnings and establish 'guardrails' echoes the ancient wisdom of Proverbs 27:12: 'The prudent see danger and take cover.' This calls for foresight and careful planning to navigate the complex ethical and...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，其潜在的益处和危害日益显现。路易丝·海呼吁听取专家警告并建立“护栏”，这与箴言 27:12 的古老智慧不谋而合：“通达人见祸藏躲。”这要求我们具备远见卓识和审慎规划，以应对未来复杂的伦理和安全挑战。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Reform UK ‘has no interest in Wales’, says Senedd member who defected to Plaid Cymru – as it happened
title.zh: 法拉奇称，如果工会阻碍 7200 万英镑捐款，改革党政府将停止工会资助工党——英国政治直播

summary.en: Reform UK party leader Nigel Farage claims proposed retrospective laws are unfair and that his party would retaliate with a crackdown on union funding if elected. This statement comes amid discussions about trade union donations to the Labour party and multi-million pound donations to Reform UK from cryptocurrency...
summary.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇声称，拟议中的溯及性法律不公平，如果他领导的政党当选，将通过打击工会资金来报复。此番言论是在讨论工会向工党捐款以及加密货币亿万富翁向英国改革党捐赠数百万英镑的背景下发表的。商业大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹则认为，工会的捐款代表着成千上万普通民众的贡献，而非单一实体的捐赠。

body.en: Sarah Cooper-Lesadd says party is ‘far more interested in division, opposition and headlines than finding solutions’ Leader of Reform UK in Wales stands down after arrest on suspicion of assault The Liberal Democrats have said that they will try to introduce a cap on the amount people donate to political parties by amending the representation of the people bill as it goes through the Lords. Lisa Smart , the Lib Dem Cabinet Office spokesperson, said: We can’t keep playing whack-a-mole with each new attempt by Farage to sell out our democracy. Labour’s residency requirements aren’t good enough and the Conservatives simply sat on their hands whilst in power. For decades governments of both colours have stood by and done nothing. The scale of donations made to Reform in recent days is unprecedented in British politics and should deeply concern anyone who cares about the health and integrity of our democracy. We cannot afford to see the Americanisation of our politics, with out of control political spending, funded by stratospheric sums of crypto and corporate cash. These donations show clearly whose side Reform are on, with crypto billionaires, foreign and powerful corporate interests lining up to pour in eye-watering sums of money to advance their agendas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该党领导人声称，提议的新追溯法是不公平的，如果当选的商务部长乔纳森·雷诺兹今天早上代表政府进行媒体采访，改革将通过打击工会资金进行报复。当被问及工会向工党的捐款类似于加密货币亿万富翁向改革英国捐款的数百万英镑的说法时（参见上午 9 点 09 分），雷诺兹声称将它们视为等同的说法是错误的。他告诉时代广播电台：当我们谈论或人们谈论工会捐款时，那不是一个实体。那是数以万计的普通人选择进行的捐款，并且是由工会捆绑并提供的。但很容易选择不这样做。有管理政治资金、政治选票的规则。老实说，我认为将这些超级加密货币改革捐助者与选择向政治体系捐献一些钱的劳动人民自愿协会进行比较，我认为这两件事没有可比性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political discourse often devolves into threats of retaliation, where proposed actions are met with counter-threats. This cycle can obscure the fundamental call for justice and fairness. The prophet Micah reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide all public life.
reflection.zh: 政治言论常常陷入相互报复的威胁之中，一项提议的行动会招致反击。这种循环可能会掩盖对公正和公平的基本呼吁。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的领导力在于秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑同行于雅伟，这些原则应当指导所有公共生活。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Trump EPA moves to wipe out climate rules for power plants
title.zh: 特朗普政府拟取消发电厂气候规则

summary.en: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has announced a plan to dismantle key Biden-era regulations aimed at limiting greenhouse gas emissions from power plants, arguing that these emissions do not have a significant impact on climate change. This move comes after the hottest summer on record and a UN report...
summary.zh: 美国国家环境保护局（EPA）宣布了一项计划，旨在废除拜登政府时期旨在限制发电厂温室气体排放的关键规定，并声称这些排放对气候变化没有重大影响。此举发生在美国经历有记录以来最热的夏天以及联合国发布一份强调气候风险不断升级的报告之后。

body.en: On the heels of the hottest summer on record and a United Nations report warning that global temperatures are likely to push climate risks to “increasingly dangerous heights,” the Trump administration overturned most of a Biden-era rule limiting climate pollution from power plants, the second-largest source of greenhouse gas emissions. The Environmental Protection Agency announced a final plan Monday that guts the 2024 Carbon Pollution Standards, which the agency said exceeds its authority under the Clean Air Act by requiring control technologies “that are not adequately demonstrated.” The agency also proposed revoking “all remaining GHG emissions requirements for power plants,” arguing their emissions “have no material impact on climate change.” The plan to revoke the Carbon Pollution Standards was initially revealed last spring . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在经历了有记录以来最热的夏季以及联合国报告警告全球气温可能将气候风险推向“日益危险的高度”之后，特朗普政府推翻了拜登时代限制发电厂气候污染的大部分规则，发电厂是第二大温室气体排放源。美国环境保护局周一宣布了一项最终计划，该计划对 2024 年碳污染标准进行了修改，该机构表示，该标准超出了《清洁空气法》规定的权力，因为它要求采用“尚未得到充分论证”的控制技术。该机构还提议撤销“发电厂所有剩余的温室气体排放要求”，称其排放“对气候变化没有实质性影响”。取消碳污染标准的计划最初是在去年春天公布的。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the face of overwhelming scientific evidence and a UN warning about escalating climate risks, the EPA has moved to dismantle regulations on power plant emissions. This decision raises profound questions about our stewardship of the Earth, which belongs to Yahweh. We are called to care for creation, not to disregard its well-being for short-term or...
reflection.zh: 面对压倒性的科学证据和联合国关于气候风险不断升级的警告，美国国家环境保护局已着手拆除对发电厂排放的监管。这一决定引发了关于我们如何管理属于雅伟的地球的深刻问题。我们被呼召去关爱受造物，而不是为了短期或政治利益而忽视它的福祉。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
title.zh: 英威尔士酒吧允许使用数字身份证应用程序证明年龄

summary.en: New rules mean pubs and shops in England and Wales can accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents to verify age, aiming for quicker and more secure checks.
summary.zh: 新规意味着英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店可以接受数字身份证应用程序以及实体证件来验证年龄，旨在实现更快、更安全的检查。

body.en:
Alcohol buyers will be able to use a digital ID app on their phones to prove their age under new rules introduced on Tuesday.

Pubs and shops in England and Wales can use the tech in addition to current physical forms of ID - with the government saying a digital option will make age-checks quicker and more secure for customers and staff.

Customers will be able to choose ID apps from a range of suppliers such as the Post Office, Yoti or Luciditi, provided they are on a government-approved list.

The change means businesses will no longer be required to let people use physical ID, but the government contends most establishments would.

The plan will be technology-agnostic, meaning that the government is not setting out in detail how each app must work.

It argues that under the voluntary digital ID scheme, drinkers would share fewer personal details with a venue or shop - such as tapping their phone on a reader or displaying a scannable QR code rather than handing over an official document.

The apps will also need to guard against customers borrowing devices from older friends and relatives, and ensure the ID app belongs to the person using it.

Yoti's digital ID app, for example, will only let a user log in if a scan of their face matches that of the person who signed up for the app.

The app then generates a QR code that can be scanned by a business with a free checker app, which tells them the person's age.

Digital government minister Stephanie Peacock said having the option for digital ID would "mean you do not need to carry a physical ID, nor hand over sensitive personal information" meaning people could "feel safer on a night out'".

Allen Simpson, chief executive of trade body UKHospitality, said the new rules were a "positive step".

He added the industry would work with government to make sure the scheme's roll-out would not be "burdensome" for the hospitality sector.

This would include ensuring there were multiple options for suppliers and that it was cost-efficient, Simpson said.

The government wants digital ID apps under its scheme to work together so customers do not need to use different apps in different venues.

It also wants the services to work offline and accessible even without mobile data or a Wi-Fi connection.

In future, the digital proof of age scheme could be extended to cover tobacco and vapes.

But digital rights campaigners have said such measures could lead to the exclusion of some groups.

Jasleen Chaggar of Big Brother Watch said while having multiple ways to prove your identity was helpful, the Government should ensure that digital ID did not become effectively mandatory "as it would shut out millions of people".

"Many people have legitimate reasons for relying on physical ID, whether out of choice, privacy and...
body.zh: 根据周二推出的新规定，酒类购买者将能够使用手机上的数字身份应用程序来证明自己的年龄。 除了当前的实体身份证件之外，英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店还可以使用这项技术——政府表示，数字选项将使年龄检查对顾客和员工来说更快、更安全。 客户将能够从 Post Office、Yoti 或 Luciditi 等一系列供应商那里选择 ID 应用程序，前提是它们位于政府批准的列表中。 这一变化意味着企业将不再被要求让人们使用实体身份证，但政府认为大多数企业都会这样做。 该计划将与技术无关，这意味着政府不会详细说明每个应用程序必须如何运行。 它认为，根据自愿数字身份计划，饮酒者将与场所或商店分享更少的个人详细信息，例如将手机放在阅读器上或显示可扫描的二维码，而不是提交官方文件。 这些应用程序还需要防止客户从年长的朋友和亲戚那里借用设备，并确保 ID 应用程序属于使用它的人。 例如，Yoti 的数字身份证应用程序只有在面部​​扫描与注册该应用程序的人的面部扫描相匹配时才会允许用户登录。 然后，该应用程序会生成一个二维码，企业可以使用免费的检查应用程序扫描该二维码，从而得知该人的年龄。 数字政府部长斯蒂芬妮·皮科克表示，选择数字身份证“意味着你不需要携带实体身份证，也不需要交出敏感的个人信息”，这意味着人们可以“在晚上外出时感到更安全”。 贸易机构英国酒店业协会首席执行官艾伦·辛普森表示，新规定是“积极的一步”。 他补充说，该行业将与政府合作，确保该计划的推出不会给酒店业带来“负担”。 辛普森说，这包括确保供应商有多种选择，并且具有成本效益。 政府希望其计划下的数字身份应用程序能够协同工作，这样客户就不需要在不同的场所使用不同的应用程序。 它还希望这些服务能够离线工作，即使没有移动数据或 Wi-Fi 连接也可以访问。 未来，数字年龄证明计划可能会扩展到涵盖烟草和电子烟。 但数字权利活动人士表示，此类措施可能会导致某些群体被排除在外。 Big Brother Watch 的贾斯琳·查加尔 (Jasleen Chaggar) 表示，虽然有多种方法来证明你的身份很有帮助，但政府应该确保数字身份不会成为有效的强制措施，“因为这会将数百万人拒之门外”。 “许多人有合理的理由依赖实体身份证，无论是出于选择、隐私还是......

reflection.en: The digital age continues to accelerate, bringing new tools like age-verification apps. Daniel spoke of a time when knowledge would increase and many would hurry to and fro. This technological advancement is a clear sign of that prophecy being fulfilled, urging us to consider how we use this growing knowledge wisely and ethically.
reflection.zh: 数字时代持续加速，带来了诸如年龄验证应用程序之类的新工具。但以理曾预言，在末后的日子，知识将增多，人也必往返奔走。这项技术进步是这一预言实现的明显标志，促使我们思考如何明智且合乎道德地运用日益增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑，VR是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: Tom Gerken from the BBC gets hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, and finds it to be excellent hardware but questions its high price point of over £1,000.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显Steam Frame，发现其硬件表现出色，但对其超过1000英镑的高昂价格提出了质疑。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."

Of course, there are reasons for prices going up. AI developers are building giant data centres filled with racks of powerful servers, using many of the same components needed to make devices like the Steam Frame.

Ram prices alone more than doubled in price between October 2025 and the start of 2026 . Meanwhile, the graphics card I bought for £500 a few months ago now sits at closer to £650.

As prices climb higher and higher, hardware developers don't have much of a choice but to put up their own.

"We set out to come out with a device that would have been much more affordable," Valve developer Jeremy Selan said.

"But the global Ram market has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody."

"The idea that it's too expensive is one of the biggest...
body.zh: Valve 的新款虚拟现实耳机 Steam Frame 已正式发布，但价格高昂。 其硬件非常出色，是一款佩戴舒适、采用巧妙技术的轻便设备，只要您愿意花 1,089 英镑购买一款具有 1TB 存储空间的耳机。 两者都能够从 PC 上进行流媒体播放，也能够在设备上玩游戏，并取得了不同程度的成功。 但它的价格标签会让很多人翻白眼，而且并不能消除人们对日益昂贵的虚拟现实头显让人们放弃这项爱好的批评。 但在我们讨论这个高昂的价格之前，Steam Frame 真的好吗？ 我拥有 VR 耳机已有十多年了，Valve 的最新成果给我留下了美好的第一印象。 游戏运行良好——考虑到价格标签，这确实是最低限度——而且它很容易使用。 优点之一是，与 Meta 的 Quest 3 一样，它具有扁平的“煎饼”镜片，让您戴上耳机时可以清晰地看到。 它很轻——只比一罐汤重一点。但让它感到舒适的是决定将内部结构分开。 电池组位于您的后脑勺上，而屏幕位于前面，这意味着您不会感到前部沉重，这是其他耳机常见的批评。 但还有更好的屏幕。例如，PlayStation VR2 拥有令人难以置信的 OLED 显示屏，尽管没有薄饼镜头。 然而，这些产品的溢价非常高，其成本远远高于 Steam Frame。 当 Meta 于 2023 年 6 月推出 Quest 3 时，其 128GB 型号的零售价为 480 英镑。存储空间更少，但价格却低得多。 三年后，当 Quest 3 感觉像是一个转折点时，很难相信 VR 会变得越来越贵。 “今天的虚拟现实最终是一个高端利基市场，”游戏作家克里斯托弗·德林告诉我。 “Meta 一直在补贴 Quest 硬件，很难想象他们会在放弃这些体验时继续前进。” 当然，价格上涨是有原因的。人工智能开发人员正在建造巨大的数据中心，其中充满了强大服务器的机架，使用许多与制造 Steam Frame 等设备所需的相同组件。 从 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年初，仅公羊的价格就上涨了一倍多。与此同时，我几个月前花 500 英镑购买的显卡现在价格接近 650 英镑。 随着价格越来越高，硬件开发商别无选择，只能自己开发。 Valve 开发者杰里米·塞兰 (Jeremy Selan) 表示：“我们打算推出一款价格更加实惠的设备。” “但全球公羊市场对我们的影响就像对每个人的影响一样。” “价格太贵是最大的想法之一......

reflection.en: The Steam Frame headset is lauded for its excellent technology and comfortable design, but its steep price of £1,089 raises questions about accessibility. This echoes the biblical caution that while knowledge and capability may advance, not everything that can be done is necessarily beneficial or wise for all people.
reflection.zh: Steam Frame头显因其出色的技术和舒适的设计而受到赞扬，但其高达1089英镑的昂贵价格引发了关于可及性的问题。这呼应了圣经中的告诫：虽然知识和能力可能在进步，但并非所有能做到的事情都对所有人有益或明智。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: What is AI, how does it work and why are some people concerned about it?
title.zh: 人工智能是什么，它是如何工作的，为什么有些人担心它？

summary.en: AI is transforming modern life, but not without worry for some that it may be abused or have an adverse environmental impact.
summary.zh: 人工智能正在改变现代生活，但有些人担心它可能被滥用或对环境产生不利影响。

body.en:
The technology takes many forms - from personalising social media feeds to spotting friends in smartphone photos - and accelerating medical breakthroughs.

But the rise of chatbots like OpenAI's ChatGPT has prompted concern about the tech's environmental impact, ethical implications and data use.

Recent claims that AI could become too powerful and threaten humanity have also triggered calls for slower development and tighter regulation.

AI allows computers to process large amounts of data, identify patterns and follow detailed instructions about what to do with that information.

However, scientists have developed systems that can perform tasks which usually require human intelligence, trying to replicate how people acquire and use knowledge.

This could be trying to anticipate what product an online shopper might buy, based on previous purchases, in order to recommend items.

The technology is also behind voice-controlled virtual assistants like Apple's Siri and Amazon's Alexa, and is being used to develop systems for self-driving cars.

AI also helps social platforms like Facebook, TikTok and X decide what posts to show users. Streaming services Spotify and Deezer use AI to suggest music.

There are also a number of applications in medicine, as scientists use AI to help spot cancers, review X-ray results, speed up diagnoses and identify new treatments.

Generative AI is used to create new content which can seem like it has been made by a human.

It does this by learning from vast quantities of existing data such as online text and images.

ChatGPT and Chinese rival DeepSeek's chatbot are popular generative AI tools that can be used to produce text, images, code and more material.

Apps like Midjourney or Veo 3 are dedicated to creating images or video from simple text prompts.

Songs mimicking the style or sound of famous musicians have gone viral , sometimes leaving fans confused about their authenticity.

While acknowledging AI's potential, some experts are worried about the implications of its rapid growth.

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) suggested that AI could affect nearly 40% of jobs , and worsen global financial inequality.

Prof Geoffrey Hinton, a computer scientist regarded as a "godfather" of AI development, warned powerful AI systems could even make humans extinct - although his fear was dismissed by his fellow "AI godfather", Yann LeCun .

In September 2026 similar fears were raised again after some AI researchers warned the tech could threaten humanity in the near future .

But experts have urged a focus on present risks and AI dangers - such as its potential to reproduce biased information, or discriminate against some social groups .

This is because public data used to train many AI systems can reflect existing societal...
body.zh: 该技术有多种形式——从个性化社交媒体信息到在智能手机照片中识别朋友——并加速医学突破。 但 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 等聊天机器人的兴起引发了人们对该技术的环境影响、道德影响和数据使用的担忧。 最近有关人工智能可能变得过于强大并威胁人类的说法也引发了要求放慢发展和加强监管的呼声。 人工智能允许计算机处理大量数据、识别模式并遵循有关如何处理这些信息的详细说明。 然而，科学家们已经开发出可以执行通常需要人类智能的任务的系统，试图复制人们获取和使用知识的方式。 这可能是试图根据之前的购买情况来预测在线购物者可能会购买什么产品，以便推荐商品。 该技术还支持苹果 Siri 和亚马逊 Alexa 等语音控制虚拟助手，并被用于开发自动驾驶汽车系统。 人工智能还帮助 Facebook、TikTok 和 X 等社交平台决定向用户展示哪些帖子。流媒体服务 Spotify 和 Deezer 使用人工智能来推荐音乐。 人工智能在医学领域也有许多应用，科学家利用人工智能来帮助发现癌症、审查 X 射线结果、加快诊断速度并确定新的治疗方法。 生成式人工智能用于创建看起来像是人类制作的新内容。 它通过学习大量现有数据（例如在线文本和图像）来实现这一点。 ChatGPT 和中国竞争对手 DeepSeek 的聊天机器人是流行的生成式人工智能工具，可用于生成文本、图像、代码和更多材料。 Midjourney 或 Veo 3 等应用程序专门用于根据简单的文本提示创建图像或视频。 模仿著名音乐家的风格或声音的歌曲在网上疯传，有时让歌迷对它们的真实性感到困惑。 在承认人工智能的潜力的同时，一些专家担心其快速增长的影响。 国际货币基金组织（IMF）表示，人工智能可能影响近40%的就业岗位，并加剧全球金融不平等。 被视为人工智能发展“教父”的计算机科学家杰弗里·辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton）教授警告说，强大的人工智能系统甚至可能使人类灭绝——尽管他的“人工智能教父”同行扬·勒昆（Yann LeCun）驳回了他的担忧。 2026 年 9 月，一些人工智能研究人员警告该技术可能在不久的将来威胁人类后，类似的担忧再次出现。 但专家们敦促关注当前的风险和人工智能的危险，例如它可能复制有偏见的信息，或歧视某些社会群体。 这是因为用于训练许多人工智能系统的公共数据可以反映现有的社会……

reflection.en: Artificial intelligence offers remarkable advancements, from medical breakthroughs to personalized experiences. Yet, as this report notes, the rapid development of AI also brings significant ethical and environmental concerns. The Apostle Paul reminds us that while many things are permissible, not all are beneficial, urging us to consider the true impact of...
reflection.zh: 人工智能带来了非凡的进步，从医学突破到个性化体验。然而，正如本报道所指出的，人工智能的快速发展也带来了重大的伦理和环境问题。使徒保罗提醒我们，虽然许多事情是允许的，但并非所有事情都有益，敦促我们考虑我们创新的真正影响。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Report links fishmeal production to decline in key species for Guinea-Bissau communities
title.zh: 报告称鱼粉生产导致几内亚比绍社区关键物种减少

summary.en: Populations of sardinella, a crucial source of protein, are rapidly declining in Guinea-Bissau's waters. A report by OCCRP suggests this decline is linked to industrial fishing for sardinella used in fishmeal production, a product for livestock feed. However, sardinella is also a staple food for the people of...
summary.zh: 在西非几内亚比绍附近水域，作为重要蛋白质来源的沙丁鱼种群正在迅速减少。OCCRP的一份报告指出，这种下降似乎与用于生产鱼粉的沙丁鱼的工业化捕捞有关。鱼粉是一种添加到牲畜饲料中的加工鱼制品，但沙丁鱼也是几内亚比绍及其他西非国家人民的重要食物来源。

body.en: Populations of sardinella, an important protein-rich fish, are in rapid decline in the waters off Guinea-Bissau in West Africa. The decline appears to be related to industrial fishing for two species of sardinella used to make fishmeal, according to a report by investigative news organization OCCRP. In Guinea-Bissau, fish like the Madeiran sardinella (Sardinella maderensis) and round sardinella (Sardinella aurita) are among the primary ingredients in fishmeal, a processed fish product added to livestock feed for added protein and nutrients. But sardinella is also a crucial food for people in Guinea-Bissau and other West African nations. A fisheries assessment for the Guinea-Bissau government showed sardinella stocks have been decimated, according to the OCCRP report. This decline coincided with the arrival two Chinese fishmeal factories and a fleet of Turkish fishing boats off the coast of Guinea-Bissau. In an email to Mongabay, OCCRP report co-author Josef Skrdlik said the migration patterns of sardinella still aren’t fully understood, so there could be other explanations for the decline. “That said, the assessment, combined with the export data we’ve compiled, points to the Chinese-owned factory ships as the main culprits,” Skrdlik said. “The export data indicates that the production on the ships — supplied by a Turkish fleet for which sardinella was a key target — took place at a scale consistent with the decline in the sardinella stocks observed between 2013 and 2025,” he added. “In particular, fishmeal exports by a company linked to the floating factories corresponded to at least 350,000 tons…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 西非几内亚比绍海域的沙丁鱼是一种重要的富含蛋白质的鱼类，其数量正在迅速减少。据调查新闻机构 OCCRP 报道，这种下降似乎与用于制作鱼粉的两种沙丁鱼的工业捕捞有关。在几内亚比绍，马德拉沙丁鱼 (Sardinella maderensis) 和圆沙丁鱼 (Sardinella aurita) 等鱼类是鱼粉的主要成分，鱼粉是一种添加到牲畜饲料中以添加蛋白质和营养的加工鱼产品。但沙丁鱼也是几内亚比绍和其他西非国家人民的重要食物。根据 OCCRP 的报告，几内亚比绍政府的渔业评估显示，沙丁鱼种群已大量减少。这一下降恰逢两家中国鱼粉工厂和一支土耳其渔船抵达几内亚比绍海岸。 OCCRP 报告的合著者 Josef Skrdlik 在给 Mongabay 的一封电子邮件中表示，沙丁鱼的迁徙模式仍未完全了解，因此沙丁鱼数量下降可能还有其他解释。 “话虽如此，评估结果与我们编制的出口数据相结合，表明中国工厂船是罪魁祸首，”斯克德利克说。他补充说：“出口数据表明，船上的生产规模与 2013 年至 2025 年间观察到的沙丁鱼库存下降情况一致，由土耳其船队提供，沙丁鱼是该船队的主要目标。” “特别是，与浮动工厂有关的一家公司的鱼粉出口量至少达到35万吨……本文最初发表在Mongabay

reflection.en: The report from Guinea-Bissau reveals a stark conflict between industrial interests and community sustenance. When the pursuit of profit through fishmeal production directly harms the food security and livelihoods of local populations, it raises profound ethical questions about justice and accountability. We are called to seek justice, show mercy, and walk...
reflection.zh: 来自几内亚比绍的报道揭示了工业利益与社区生计之间的严峻冲突。当通过鱼粉生产追求利润直接损害当地民众的粮食安全和生计时，就引发了关于公正和问责的深刻伦理问题。我们被呼召寻求公正，喜爱怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行，确保人类的活动服务于弱势群体，而非剥削他们。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Since US intervention, Venezuela’s illegal mining crisis has only worsened, critics say
title.zh: 自美国干预以来，委内瑞拉非法采矿危机愈演愈烈，批评人士称

summary.en: U.S. Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum met with Venezuelan officials and mining executives in Caracas to discuss establishing a legitimate mining sector and removing criminal groups. The trip, following a U.S. military operation that removed President Nicolás Maduro, aims to attract foreign investment to...
summary.zh: 美国内政部长道格·伯格姆在加拉加斯会见了委内瑞拉官员和矿业高管，讨论建立合法的采矿业并清除犯罪团伙。此次访问是在美国军事行动推翻总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗之后进行的，旨在吸引外国投资委内瑞拉可能价值数十亿美元的矿业，标志着该国新时代的到来。

body.en: U.S. Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum traveled to Venezuela in March with over a dozen mining company executives, holding a meeting in Caracas with local officials to discuss creating a “legitimate mining sector” and removing the criminal groups that currently operate at many mine sites. The economic potential of Venezuela’s mining sector, he said, could be worth billions. Burgum’s trip came just a few months after a U.S. military operation removed then-President Nicolás Maduro and transported him to a detention center in the U.S. state of New York. Since then, officials have heralded a new era for Venezuela, and tried to make the mining sector more attractive to foreign investment: Passing mining reform laws, taking down leaders of criminal groups involved in mining, and raiding illegal mining sites. The U.S. is also considering an executive order aimed at improving access to critical minerals, Reuters reported. Yet at the same time, observers say the illegal mining crisis is getting worse, not better. Illegal mining has expanded this year, in some cases in protected areas, and criminal groups involved in mining have tightened their hold in many parts of the country, according to sources contacted by Mongabay. “[Since Maduro’s capture], nothing has changed in the criminal and legal ecosystem,” Cristina Burelli, founder of SOSOrinoco, an advocacy group studying the social and environmental impacts of mining in Venezuela, told Mongabay. “If anything, we have seen an increase in certain areas.” Vendors weigh and trade gold at gold-buying shops in El Callao, Venezuela.…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 美国内政部长道格·布尔古姆 (Doug Burgum) 今年 3 月与十几名矿业公司高管一起前往委内瑞拉，在加拉加斯与当地官员举行会议，讨论建立“合法采矿业”并清除目前在许多矿场活动的犯罪集团。他说，委内瑞拉采矿业的经济潜力可能价值数十亿美元。布尔古姆此行的几个月前，美国的一次军事行动将时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗赶下台，并将他送往美国纽约州的一个拘留中心。从那时起，官员们预示着委内瑞拉进入了一个新时代，并试图让采矿业对外国投资更具吸引力：通过采矿改革法，打倒参与采矿的犯罪集团领导人，并突击搜查非法采矿场所。据路透社报道，美国还在考虑一项旨在改善关键矿物获取的行政命令。但与此同时，观察人士表示，非法采矿危机不但没有好转，反而变得更加严重。据 Mongabay 联系的消息人士称，今年非法采矿活动有所扩大，有时是在保护区，参与采矿的犯罪团伙在该国许多地区加强了控制。 “[自马杜罗被捕以来]，犯罪和法律生态系统没有任何变化，”研究委内瑞拉采矿社会和环境影响的倡导组织 SSOrinoco 的创始人克里斯蒂娜·布雷利 (Cristina Burelli) 告诉 Mongabay。 “如果说有什么不同的话，那就是我们在某些领域看到了增长。”供应商在委内瑞拉埃尔卡亚俄的黄金购买商店称重和交易黄金。…本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The pursuit of economic potential in Venezuela's mining sector, as discussed by U.S. officials, raises questions of justice and accountability. Micah 6:8 calls for acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, principles essential for any nation seeking to build a 'legitimate sector' free from exploitation and criminal influence.
reflection.zh: 美国官员讨论的委内瑞拉矿业经济潜力，引发了对公正和问责的思考。弥迦书6章8节呼吁行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行，这些原则对于任何希望建立一个摆脱剥削和犯罪影响的“合法行业”的国家至关重要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Dhaka’s waste-to-energy project faces opposition from pollution-weary residents
title.zh: 达卡垃圾发电项目面临污染厌倦居民的反对

summary.en: Yeasmin Begum, a lifelong resident near Dhaka's Amin Bazar landfill, suffers from allergies triggered by the stench and smoke from burning waste. Authorities plan a waste-to-energy project to incinerate 30,000 metric tons of trash daily for electricity generation, a move that worries residents about worsening...
summary.zh: 叶斯敏·贝古姆一生都居住在达卡阿明巴扎尔垃圾填埋场附近，她饱受垃圾焚烧产生的恶臭和烟雾引发的过敏困扰。当局计划实施一项垃圾发电项目，每日焚烧3万吨垃圾以发电，但居民担心这将加剧污染。

body.en: At years old, Yeasmin Begum has lived near the Amin Bazar landfill on the outskirts of Dhaka her whole life. She says the stench often triggers allergies, including colds and coughing. “Sometimes it is quite difficult for us to breathe when waste collectors burn the waste under the open sky. Smoke and ashes envelop our home and surroundings,” she says. That’s a problem that could get worse under a plan by municipal authorities to burn trash on a much larger scale. A so-called waste-to-energy project would incinerate up to 3,0000 metric tons of trash daily to heat a boiler, which would then produce steam to drive a turbine, thereby generating electricity. This would be the first-ever waste-to-energy project in Bangladesh, part of an effort to tackle the increasing volume of municipal waste. But the 42.5-megawatt North Dhaka project has raised concerns among nearby communities that have long suffered from exposure to polluted air, water, and soil. Dhaka North City Corporation is the municipal authority overseeing the project, which is owned by the China Machinery Engineering Corporation. Some of the total $467 million in total funding has been pledged by multilateral lenders including the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the New Development Bank, both headquartered in China. The project is due to be completed by December 2028, four years later than initially planned. For nearby residents like Yeasmin, the prospect of thousands of tons of municipal waste every being burned every day, potentially releasing toxic substances like heavy metals and dioxins,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 耶斯明·贝古姆 (Yeasmin Begum) 几岁时，一直住在达卡郊区的阿明巴扎尔垃圾填埋场附近。她说，恶臭经常引发过敏，包括感冒和咳嗽。 “有时，当垃圾收集者在露天焚烧垃圾时，我们会感到呼吸困难。烟雾和灰烬笼罩着我们的家和周围环境，”她说。如果市政当局计划更大规模地焚烧垃圾，这个问题可能会变得更糟。一个所谓的垃圾发电项目每天将焚烧多达 30000 吨垃圾来加热锅炉，然后产生蒸汽来驱动涡轮机，从而发电。这将是孟加拉国第一个垃圾发电项目，是解决城市垃圾数量不断增加的努力的一部分。但 42.5 兆瓦的北达卡项目引起了附近社区的担忧，这些社区长期遭受空气、水和土壤污染。达卡北方城市公司是负责监督该项目的市政当局，该项目隶属于中国机械设备工程股份有限公司。总资金额为 4.67 亿美元，其中部分资金已由总部位于中国的亚洲基础设施投资银行和金砖国家新开发银行等多边贷款机构承诺提供。该项目预计于 2028 年 12 月完工，比原计划晚了四年。对于像 Yeasmin 这样的附近居民来说，每天焚烧数千吨城市垃圾，可能会释放出重金属和二恶英等有毒物质……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The residents of Dhaka are experiencing the direct consequences of unchecked waste. Genesis 2:15 calls humanity to 'work and take care of' creation. This principle reminds us that our stewardship of the earth includes managing the byproducts of our lives, ensuring that progress does not come at the cost of the environment and the health of its inhabitants.
reflection.zh: 达卡居民正承受着失控垃圾带来的直接后果。《创世记》2章15节呼吁人类“耕种和照料”受造物。这一原则提醒我们，我们对大地的管理包括处理我们生活产生的副产品，确保发展不以牺牲环境和居民健康为代价。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Indonesian wildfires threaten leading orangutan research site in Borneo
title.zh: 印度尼西亚野火威胁婆罗洲猩猩主要研究地

summary.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans are fleeing their forest homes as staff at the Cabang Panti research site work tirelessly to combat a wildfire. The blaze has reached within 200 meters of the Rangkong research station, a satellite of the main Cabang Panti station in Gunung Palung national park, threatening one...
summary.zh: 极度濒危的婆罗洲猩猩正逃离森林家园，而卡邦潘提研究站的工作人员正不懈努力地扑灭野火。大火已逼近 Gunung Palung 国家公园内卡邦潘提研究站卫星站Rangkong研究站200米以内，威胁着全球最长期的野生猿类研究之一。

body.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans flee forests as staff at Cabang Panti work round the clock to stave off blaze Wildfires in Indonesia are sweeping through a critical research site for Bornean orangutans and are now threatening a celebrated research camp, home to one of the world’s longest-running studies of wild apes. In the past few days, the fires have burned within 200 metres of Rangkong research station, a satellite of Cabang Panti research station, which lies about four miles north in Gunung Palung national park. Continue reading...
body.zh: 极度濒临灭绝的婆罗洲猩猩逃离森林，卡邦潘蒂的工作人员昼夜不停地工作以扑灭大火。印度尼西亚的野火正在席卷婆罗洲猩猩的一个重要研究地点，现在正威胁着一个著名的研究营地，这里是世界上进行时间最长的野生猿研究的所在地。过去几天，大火已蔓延至Rangkong研究站200米范围内，Rangkong研究站是Cabang Panti研究站的卫星，位于Gunung Palung国家公园以北约4英里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The fires raging through Borneo's forests are a stark reminder of creation's vulnerability. The orangutans' flight and the researchers' desperate efforts to save their site echo the Apostle Paul's description of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting redemption. May we recognize our role in stewarding this fragile world and act with greater care.
reflection.zh: 在婆罗洲森林中肆虐的大火，是对受造界脆弱性的严峻提醒。猩猩的逃离和研究人员拯救其研究点的绝望努力，呼应了使徒保罗所描述的，万物一同劳苦叹息，等候得赎的情形。愿我们认识到自己在这脆弱世界上的管家之责，并以更大的关怀去行动。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Thousands of sea turtles reach Mexico in yearly migration threatened by climate crisis – video
title.zh: 数千只海龟抵达墨西哥进行年度迁徙，但面临气候危机的威胁——视频

summary.en: Over 330,000 sea turtles arrived in southern Mexico for a mass nesting event known as an ‘arribada’. This sixth arribada of the season saw thousands of turtles gather on the beach in less than 48 hours to lay eggs. While these turtles play a vital role in marine ecosystems, the climate crisis poses a significant...
summary.zh: 超过33万只海龟抵达墨西哥南部，进行了一场被称为“arribada”的大规模筑巢活动。本季的第六次arribada活动在不到48小时内吸引了数千只海龟聚集在海滩上产卵。尽管这些海龟在海洋生态系统中扮演着至关重要的角色，但气候危机对其生存构成了重大威胁。

body.en: More than 330,000 sea turtles arrived in southern Mexico in a mass nesting phenomenon known as an ‘arribada’. The sixth arribada of the season, which began in March, brought thousands of turtles to the beach in less than 48 hours to lay their eggs, according to officials at La Escobilla beach sanctuary in Oaxaca, Mexico. The olive ridley turtle plays a fundamental role in marine and coastal ecosystems by contributing nutrients to beach-dune systems and regulating populations of jellyfish and sponges, according to Mexico's federal attorney for environmental protection, but the climate crisis is now threatening their survival Continue reading...
body.zh: 超过 33 万只海龟抵达墨西哥南部，形成了一种被称为“arribada”的大规模筑巢现象。据墨西哥瓦哈卡州拉埃斯科比拉海滩保护区的官员称，从 3 月份开始的第六次海龟海龟季节在不到 48 小时内就吸引了数千只海龟来到海滩产卵。墨西哥联邦环境保护检察官表示，橄榄龟在海洋和沿海生态系统中发挥着重要作用，它为海滩沙丘系统提供营养，调节水母和海绵的数量，但气候危机现在正威胁着它们的生存继续阅读...

reflection.en: The incredible sight of over 330,000 olive ridley sea turtles gathering on Mexican shores for their annual nesting is a testament to the enduring rhythms of creation. Yet, this natural wonder is now imperiled by the climate crisis, a stark reminder that all of creation groans, awaiting redemption. May we be moved by such sights to care for the fragile...
reflection.zh: 超过33万只橄榄绿海龟聚集在墨西哥海岸进行年度筑巢的壮观景象，是造物界持久节律的证明。然而，这一自然奇观如今却因气候危机而受到威胁，这严峻地提醒我们，万物都在一同叹息，等待救赎。愿我们被这样的景象所感动，去关爱那托付给我们、脆弱而美丽的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: NSW bumper canola crops shine on – in pictures
title.zh: 新南威尔士州的大丰收油菜花田——图片集

summary.en: Vibrant yellow fields of canola are illuminating the landscape, as an ideal growing season leads to crops flowering earlier than usual in the south-west slopes and Riverina regions of New South Wales.
summary.zh: 在理想的生长季节下，新南威尔士州西南部斜坡和里维纳地区的油菜花田呈现出鲜艳的黄色，比往常更早开花，照亮了整个大地。

reflection.en: The bounty of the canola fields in New South Wales is a testament to the intricate systems of creation. It reminds us of the immense wisdom and diversity that Yahweh has woven into the natural world, providing sustenance and beauty. May we continue to marvel at and care for this creation, recognizing the divine artistry in every bloom and harvest.
reflection.zh: 新南威尔士州油菜花田的丰饶，是造物精妙系统的明证。它提醒我们雅伟将何等浩瀚的智慧与多样性编织进自然界，提供滋养与美丽。 愿我们继续惊叹并守护这创造，在每一朵花、每一次收获中，都看见神圣的艺术。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: From Indigenous Loss, a Potent Legal Argument on Climate
title.zh: 从原住民的损失中，一个强有力的气候法律论点

summary.en: Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon discusses how global warming endangers not only the existence of small island nations but also the cultural traditions of their Indigenous inhabitants. He is incorporating these harms into legal challenges, which have already seen a significant victory at the International Court of...
summary.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿圭恩探讨了全球变暖如何不仅威胁到小岛屿国家的生存，也威胁到其原住民的传统。他正在将这些伤害纳入法律诉讼，包括在国际法院取得重大胜利。

body.en:
Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon explores how warming threatens not only the survival of small island nations but also the traditions of their Indigenous peoples. He is citing these injuries in legal actions, including in a major victory at the International Court of Justice last year.

Last year, the International Court of Justice unanimously ruled that countries have a legal obligation to limit greenhouse gas emissions. The decision was the culmination of a years-long campaign launched by a group of law students in the Pacific island nation of Vanuatu.

The landmark opinion , which said countries’ failure to address emissions from fossil fuels and other sources could carry legal consequences, provides a potentially powerful new tool for communities, organizations, or governments suing in national courts to compel climate action or win damages. It could also push international climate negotiators toward a more aggressive stance on a danger the judges called “urgent and existential.”

Julian Aguon, an Indigenous Chamorro human rights lawyer from Guam, wore a garland of coconut fronds and cowry shells as he argued Vanuatu’s case in The Hague. He and his colleagues had traveled across Melanesia and Micronesia to gather testimony from residents whose homes, cultures, and livelihoods are being devastated by climate change.

While the impact of climate change is typically measured in degrees of warming, feet of flooding, or monetary losses, for many Indigenous people it is inflicting a profound cultural, spiritual, and emotional injury that the sterile language of science and economics fails to capture, said Aguon, founder of the Guam-based Indigenous rights and environmental justice firm Blue Ocean Law. In an interview with Yale Environment 360, he said that highlighting the harms Indigenous peoples and cultures are suffering proved a potent legal strategy at the United Nations’ main judicial body.

“Climate change is unraveling the very terms by which people know themselves and keep covenant with the natural world.” In the ICJ case, he said, “we brought that to the court’s attention because these are rights violations of the highest order — violations of the right to life, the right to culture, the right to self-determination.”

Yale Environment 360 : Can you tell me about the testimonies you and your colleagues gathered when you traveled to Vanuatu, Fiji, and other island nations in preparation for the case? How did they shape your arguments in court?

Julian Aguon : There’s no way to translate the urgency and gravity of the climate crisis other than via firsthand accounts of loss and damage, so we wanted to foreground vulnerable communities’ experiences. The process revealed in spectacular ways just how emaciated the global discourse on climate harms...
body.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿古恩探讨了气候变暖如何不仅威胁小岛屿国家的生存，而且威胁其土著人民的传统。他在法律诉讼中引用了这些伤害，包括去年在国际法院取得的重大胜利。 去年，国际法院一致裁定各国有限制温室气体排放的法律义务。这一决定是太平洋岛国瓦努阿图的一群法律学生发起的长达数年运动的高潮。 这一具有里程碑意义的意见指出，各国未能解决化石燃料和其他来源的排放问题可能会带来法律后果，为社区、组织或政府在国家法院提起诉讼以强制采取气候行动或赢得损害赔偿提供了一个潜在的强大新工具。它还可能促使国际气候谈判代表对法官所说的“紧迫且事关生死存亡”的危险采取更积极的立场。 来自关岛的查莫罗原住民人权律师朱利安·阿古恩 (Julian Aguon) 在海牙为瓦努阿图的案件辩护时戴着椰子叶和贝壳制成的花环。他和他的同事们走遍了美拉尼西亚和密克罗尼西亚，收集那些家园、文化和生计正受到气候变化破坏的居民的证词。 总部位于关岛的原住民权利和环境正义公司“蓝海法”的创始人阿古恩表示，虽然气候变化的影响通常以变暖程度、洪水深度或金钱损失来衡量，但对许多原住民来说，它正在造成深刻的文化、精神和情感伤害，这是科学和经济学语言无法捕捉到的。在接受耶鲁环境 360 采访时，他表示，事实证明，强调土著人民和文化所遭受的伤害是联合国主要司法机构的有效法律策略。 “气候变化正在瓦解人们认识自己并与自然世界保持契约的条件。”他说，在国际法院案件中，“我们提请法院注意这一点，因为这些都是最高级别的侵犯权利行为——侵犯生命权、文化权和自决权。” 耶鲁环境 360：您能告诉我您和您的同事在前往瓦努阿图、斐济和其他岛国准备此案时收集的证词吗？他们如何影响你在法庭上的论点？ 朱利安·阿古恩：除了通过损失和损害的第一手资料之外，没有其他方法可以体现气候危机的紧迫性和严重性，因此我们希望突出弱势社区的经历。这一过程以惊人的方式揭示了全球关于气候危害的讨论是多么的无力……

reflection.en: In the face of climate change, the voices of Indigenous peoples and small island nations are often drowned out. Julian Aguon's legal advocacy, however, amplifies their suffering and demands accountability, embodying the principle of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves. His work reminds us that justice requires us to champion the cause of the...
reflection.zh: 面对气候变化，原住民和小岛屿国家的呼声常常被淹没。然而，朱利安·阿圭恩的法律倡导放大了他们的痛苦，并要求问责，体现了为那些不能为自己发声的人说话的原则。他的工作提醒我们，正义要求我们为弱势群体争取权益，确保他们的困境被听到和解决。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

body.en: Priestcliffe Lees, Derbyshire: What a sight – and sound – it was, this huge flock of juveniles, feeding as the wind thrashed the vegetation Stands of tufted hair-grass, some over a metre tall, burned beige by the summer heat, were churned by strong autumn westerlies. Over and through the vegetation’s swaying lather roved a flock of about 200 goldfinches, most of them this year’s young. They were intent on the hanks of thistle and knapweed seed which lay below the hair-grass “canopy”. These immature finches lack any of the red and black bands of the adult’s head. Instead of the smooth mocha buff on their parents’ underparts, the youngsters were dull and streaky. What they had to perfection were the semi-circular disks of yellow across each black wing, while every feather through that full fan was tipped with white. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The author describes a vibrant scene at Priestcliffe Lees, where about 200 young goldfinches feed amidst the wind-tossed grasses. This vivid display of life, a part of Yahweh's creation, is in a state of flux, subject to the elements and the cycles of nature. The Apostle Paul speaks of all creation groaning as it awaits its ultimate redemption and renewal.
reflection.zh: 作者在普里斯特克利夫草地描绘了一幅生动的景象，约200只年轻的金翅雀在风吹草动的草丛中觅食。这充满活力的生命景象，是雅伟创造的一部分，正处于变化之中，受制于自然界的元素和循环。使徒保罗谈到，万物都在一同叹息，等候着最终的救赎和更新。

verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

summary.en: Iceland is one of only three countries, alongside Norway and Japan, that still permits commercial whaling. However, the Icelandic government is set to introduce a bill in February that could lead to a ban on the practice. This year, Iceland has permitted the hunting of up to 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales by its...

body.en:
Iceland is one of just three countries, along with Norway and Japan, that still allows commercial whaling in its waters, but that may be about to change. The Icelandic government will put forward a bill in February that could ban the practice.

The Icelandic government will allow for as many as 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales to be killed this year by its last remaining whaling company, Hvalur. While minke whales are not a threatened species, fin whales are classified as vulnerable to extinction by the International Union for Conservation of Nature. So far this year, 80 adult fin whales have been killed in Iceland, where authorities have found that harpooned animals often endure immense suffering. A 2023 report released by the Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority determined that some harpooned whales can take up to two hours to die. The government is now looking to update its whaling law, it says, and will consider a permanent ban on whaling. “This is a really significant milestone in efforts to consign to history Iceland’s cruel and needless whale hunts,” said Wendy Higgins , a spokesperson for Humane World for Animals.

Over the past two decades, Icelandic whalers have killed more than 1,000 fin whales, according to Humane World for Animals, which says that most of the whale meat produced is consumed not by Icelanders but by visiting tourists.

Whaling in the early 20th century decimated populations of cetaceans around the world, leading countries to agree to an international ban on whale hunting in 1986. Despite the ban, Norway resumed commercial whaling in 1993, Iceland in 2006, and Japan in 2019.
body.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍然允许在其水域进行商业捕鲸的国家之一，但这种情况可能即将改变。冰岛政府将于二月份提出一项法案，可能禁止这种做法。 冰岛政府今年将允许其最后一家捕鲸公司 Hvalur 捕杀多达 134 头小须鲸和 150 头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸不是受威胁物种，但长须鲸被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。今年到目前为止，冰岛已有 80 头成年长须鲸被杀，当局发现被鱼叉刺伤的动物常常承受巨大的痛苦。冰岛食品和兽医局 2023 年发布的一份报告确定，一些鱼叉鲸可能需要两个小时才能死亡。政府表示，目前正在寻求更新捕鲸法，并将考虑永久禁止捕鲸。人道动物世界发言人温迪·希金斯 (Wendy Higgins) 表示：“这确实是一个重要的里程碑，旨在让冰岛残忍和不必要的鲸鱼捕猎成为历史。” 根据动物人道世界的数据，在过去的二十年里，冰岛捕鲸者已经捕杀了 1000 多头长须鲸，该组织表示，生产的大部分鲸肉不是由冰岛人食用，而是由来访的游客食用。 20 世纪初的捕鲸活动导致世界各地的鲸目动物数量锐减，导致各国于 1986 年同意国际禁止捕鲸。尽管有这项禁令，挪威还是于 1993 年恢复了商业捕鲸，冰岛于 2006 年恢复了商业捕鲸，日本于 2019 年恢复了商业捕鲸。

The potential ban reflects a growing awareness and a moral imperative to protect species facing extinction....

Rose Abdoo is ready to go back to Stars Hollow. The actress, best known for playing Gypsy on “ Gilmore Girls ” and Josefina on the Emmy-winning “Hacks,” recently told IndieWire she’s eager to participate in an upcoming documentary about the beloved WB and CW series.

“I sent Lauren [Graham] a message immediately saying, ‘Please let me be involved in this in any way,’” Abdoo said, noting that she also played a second character in the “Gilmore Girls” universe. “Gypsy and Berta, double casting! I want to be in it somehow. I would love that.”

HBO Max is currently producing the untitled nonfiction project to mark the show’s 25th anniversary. It’s expected to feature creator and showrunner Amy Sherman-Palladino, executive producer Daniel Palladino, star Graham, and other cast and crew members. Interviews are expected to run alongside new behind-the-scenes footage, outtakes, and original script pages. Related Stories Michelle Khare Says YouTube’s Upload Button Is Changing Who Gets to Make Prestige TV Neil Jordan on Making His Homoerotic ‘Interview with the Vampire’ for a Major Studio with A-List Stars

Bonni Cohen directs the documentary, which doesn’t yet have a release date. But Abdoo said she just had lunch with Sally Struthers, who played Babette on the series, and told IndieWire that she remains close with many former co-stars. Abdoo is hopeful any “Gilmore Girls” documentary will capture the relationships that formed during the show’s original run.

“That was a wonderful friendship that came out of that show,” she said of Struthers.

“Gilmore Girls” originally aired on The WB from 2000 to 2006 before moving to The CW for its seventh and final season. It returned with the 2016 Netflix revival miniseries “Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life.” The fanbase has continued to grow, something Abdoo attributes to its cozy ambiance and generational storytelling.

“It’s a comforting town to be part of,” she said. “Every fall people want to just be back in Stars Hollow.” The series’ appeal, Abdoo added, comes from the way people of all ages can coexist within the same fictional universe. She also sees that quality in “ Hacks ,” where the bond between Jean Smart’s Deborah and Hannah Einbinder’s Ava bridges a significant age gap.

reflection.en: Rose Abdoo eagerly anticipates a documentary about her time on 'Gilmore Girls,' seeing it as a chance to revisit a significant chapter. This reflects the wisdom of Ecclesiastes, which reminds us that there is a time for every purpose under heaven. As she looks back with fondness and forward with anticipation, we are reminded that each season of life has its...
reflection.zh: 罗斯·阿布杜（Rose Abdoo）热切期待一部关于她在《吉尔莫女孩》时期经历的纪录片，认为这是重温人生重要篇章的机会。这呼应了《传道书》的智慧，提醒我们“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”。当我们带着怀念回顾过去，又满怀期待地展望未来时，我们被提醒，生命的每个季节都有其独特的价值和意义。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: James McNeill Whistler review – painter’s work shines through attention-grabbing life story
title.zh: 詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒评论——画家作品在引人入胜的人生故事中闪耀

summary.en: The latest Exhibition on Screen documentary balances the famous scandals of James McNeill Whistler with the subtle brilliance of his art, timed to coincide with Tate Britain’s exhibition.
summary.zh: 最新的“展览 على الشاشة”纪录片很好地平衡了詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒的著名丑闻与他艺术的微妙才华，该片与泰特不列颠的展览同期上映。

body.en: The latest Exhibition on Screen documentary does a good job balancing the famous scandals with the subtle brilliance of his art Timed to coincide with Tate Britain’s impressive gallery show – which closes at the end of September, so you haven’t long if you’ve missed it so far – this latest from the Exhibition on Screen strand does a fine job in outlining the ins and outs, and ups and downs of this still somewhat divisive artist who, Whistler’s Mother notwithstanding, is still probably most famous for winning a farthing in damages in his “flinging a pot of paint” libel action against John Ruskin. The film assembles the customary lineup of notables including the Tate’s Carol Jacobi, critic Rachel Campbell-Johnston and art historian Stephen Calloway, the latter of whom’s dandyish attire and Colonel Sanders goatee suggests he has very much bought into the Whistler aesthetic. In fact, as all the interviewees are keen to point out, Whistler’s self-constructed persona, always with an eye to making a splash, is as significant an element of his artistic presence as the art itself – even if, as I can’t be alone in thinking, there’s something fundamentally irritating about his southern-genteel attudinising even at a century and a half’s distance. Be that as it may, the film gets to grips with Whistler’s instinctive brilliance as an artist, his natural flair for boundary-pushing and forward-thinking idealism. The big life episodes – his arrival in London, painting his mother, the brouhaha over the Peacock Room , the court case and subsequent bankruptcy – are recounted, but there is impressive detail on the actual art: from the dynamics behind his brooding Wapping picture to the temper tantrums (not his) that made Harmony in Grey and Green, his portrait of the eight-year-old Cicely Alexander so distinctive. And while Whistler’s dealings with the women in his life wouldn’t exactly pass modern-era scrutiny, his pictures of them are genuinely brilliant, with especial attention given to a wonderfully tender sketch of his wife Beatrix , terminally ill in a hotel bedroom. Continue reading...
body.zh: 最新的银幕展览纪录片很好地平衡了著名的丑闻和他艺术的微妙光彩，恰逢泰特英国美术馆令人印象深刻的画廊展览——该展览将于九月底结束，所以如果你到目前为止已经错过了它，那么你也不会太久——这部银幕展览的最新纪录片很好地概述了这位仍然有些分裂的艺术家的来龙去脉和起起落落，尽管惠斯勒的母亲，他可能仍然是最著名的艺术家他在针对约翰·罗斯金的“泼一盆油漆”诽谤诉讼中赢得了一分钱的赔偿金。这部电影汇集了传统的名人阵容，包括泰特美术馆的卡罗尔·雅各比、评论家雷切尔·坎贝尔-约翰斯顿和艺术史学家斯蒂芬·卡洛韦，后者的花哨服装和桑德斯上校的山羊胡子表明他非常接受惠斯勒的审美。事实上，正如所有受访者都热衷指出的那样，惠斯勒自我塑造的形象，总是着眼于引起轰动，与艺术本身一样是他艺术存在的重要元素——尽管，正如我不能独自思考的那样，即使在一个半世纪的距离之外，他的南方文雅态度从根本上令人恼火。尽管如此，这部电影还是展现了惠斯勒作为艺术家的本能才华、突破界限和前瞻性理想主义的天赋。书中讲述了他一生中的重大事件——抵达伦敦、为母亲画画、《孔雀屋》引起的骚动、法庭案件和随后的破产——但也有关于实际艺术的令人印象深刻的细节：从他沉思的沃平画背后的动态，到使《灰绿和谐》中的脾气暴躁（不是他的），他为八岁的西塞莉·亚历山大（Cicely Alexander）所作的肖像如此独特。虽然惠斯勒与他生活中的女性的相处方式并不能完全通过现代时代的审视，但他为她们拍摄的照片确实非常精彩，尤其是他在酒店卧室里身患绝症的妻子贝娅特丽克丝的温柔素描。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary explores the life and art of James McNeill Whistler, a painter known for both his scandals and his artistic achievements. It reminds us that even in fields often associated with personal drama, the dedication to craft and the pursuit of beauty can be seen as a form of service. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to do all our work heartily, as...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了画家詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒的生活与艺术，他以丑闻和艺术成就而闻名。它提醒我们，即使在那些常与个人戏剧相关的领域，对技艺的投入和对美的追求也可以被视为一种服务。歌罗西书3:23鼓励我们凡事甘心，如同为主而做，在我们的事业中找到尊严和目标，无论它们是宏大的还是微妙的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Israeli minister threatens to revoke filmmakers' citizenship over Gaza documentary
title.zh: 以色列部长威胁取消加沙纪录片制作人公民身份

summary.en: Israel's culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli co-directors of 'Naza,' a documentary accusing the Israeli army of mass civilian killings in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship, labeling their work as 'treason against the state.' The film utilizes AI-powered targeting systems information and...
summary.zh: 以色列文化部长呼吁剥夺奥斯卡获奖影片《纳扎》的以色列联合导演的公民身份。该纪录片指控以色列军队在加沙犯下大规模平民杀戮罪行，部长称其为“叛国”。影片使用了人工智能驱动的瞄准系统信息，并采访了未透露身份的以色列军方和情报官员。

body.en:
Israel's culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli co-directors of Naza, a documentary that accuses the Israeli army of mass civilian killings in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship over "treason against the state".

Named for the Hebrew military acronym for collateral damage, the film speaks to 24 unidentified Israeli military and intelligence officers who outlined the AI-powered targeting systems used by the Israeli army to bombard Gaza in the war triggered by the Hamas-led attack on 7 October 2023.

Since then, more than 73,000 Palestinians, including more than 20,000 children, have been killed in the campaign by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, figures considered reliable by the UN. About 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage during the Hamas attack.

Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor say their 80-minute documentary "details the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza" during the war, according to its official synopsis. One of the people interviewed says there was the approval for an attack to kill 500 people for "one human target", an allegation the IDF said was "completely false".

In a post on X, Culture Minister Miki Zohar said he had asked the authorities "to investigate how the materials were obtained, who is behind them, and whether in the process of obtaining or publishing them, actions were taken that amount to aiding the enemy during wartime".

In a letter addressed to Israel's Interior Ministry, he said: "The claims presented in the film are false and distorted, and I categorically reject the attempt to portray IDF soldiers and the State of Israel as perpetrators of intentional crimes." Zohar mentioned the country's Citizenship Law, saying it "allows for the revocation of citizenship due to a 'breach of allegiance to the State of Israel'". The measure, however, has rarely been applied.

There has been no immediate reaction from Abraham and Szor. The filmmakers won an Oscar last year for No Other Land, a documentary about violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.

Naza premiered last Thursday at the Venice Film Festival, where it received a 25-minute standing ovation, but has not yet been made available to the wider public. It won a special jury prize at the festival. Speaking then, Abraham said the reporting for the film, which was produced by the UK's Guardian newspaper, had been "rigorous" and that efforts to discredit it were "attempts to not face reality".

"It's a war that has principally been killing civilians. And I think our film is showing that this is not some mistake. It's not an accident. It's something very, very systemic. And this should have been apparent to everyone, I...
body.zh: 以色列文化部长呼吁以“叛国罪”为由，剥夺奥斯卡奖得主、纪录片《纳扎》的以色列联合导演的国籍，该纪录片指责以色列军队在加沙大规模屠杀平民。 该影片以希伯来语军事缩写“附带损害”的缩写命名，讲述了 24 名身份不明的以色列军方和情报官员的故事，他们概述了以色列军队在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击引发的战争中轰炸加沙的人工智能瞄准系统。 据哈马斯管理的加沙卫生部称，自那时起，已有超过 73,000 名巴勒斯坦人在以色列国防军 (IDF) 的行动中丧生，其中包括 20,000 多名儿童，联合国认为这一数字是可靠的。哈马斯袭击造成约 1,200 人死亡，251 人被扣为人质。 根据官方简介，尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔表示，他们的 80 分钟纪录片“详细介绍了战争期间以色列在加沙有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民的幕后系统”。一名接受采访的人士表示，针对“一个人类目标”发动一次造成 500 人死亡的袭击已获得批准，但以色列国防军称这一指控“完全错误”。 文化部长米基·佐哈尔(Miki Zohar)在X上发帖称，他已要求当局“调查这些材料是如何获得的、谁是幕后黑手，以及在获得或发布这些材料的过程中是否采取了相当于战时援敌的行动”。 他在写给以色列内政部的一封信中表示：“影片中的说法是虚假和扭曲的，我坚决反对将以色列国防军士兵和以色列国描绘成故意犯罪的肇事者的企图。”佐哈尔提到了该国的公民法，称该法“允许因‘违反对以色列国的效忠’而撤销公民身份”。然而，这项措施很少得到应用。 亚伯拉罕和索尔没有立即做出反应。去年，电影制片人凭借《No Other Land》获得了奥斯卡奖，该纪录片讲述了犹太定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为。 《娜扎》上周四在威尼斯电影节上首映，获得了 25 分钟的起立鼓掌，但尚未向更广泛的公众开放。它在电影节上获得了评审团特别奖。亚伯拉罕当时表示，这部由英国《卫报》制作的电影的报道是“严谨的”，抹黑影片的努力是“试图不面对现实”。 “这是一场主要杀害平民的战争。我认为我们的电影表明这不是一个错误。这不是一次意外。这是非常非常系统性的事情。这对每个人来说都应该是显而易见的，我......

reflection.en: The filmmakers behind 'Naza' face severe repercussions for their work, which gives voice to accusations of mass civilian killings in Gaza. Their situation underscores the courage required to speak truth to power, especially when it involves challenging narratives about military actions. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to 'speak up for all the voiceless, and defend...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《纳扎》的制作人因其揭露加沙大规模平民杀戮指控的工作而面临严厉报复。他们的处境凸显了在挑战军事行动叙事时，向权力说真话所需的勇气。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为所有不能说话的人说话，为所有孤苦无依的人伸张正义”。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Israeli minister threatens to strip Israeli film-makers of citizenship over Gaza documentary NAZA
title.zh: 以色列部长威胁取消加沙纪录片制作人的公民身份

summary.en: Israel's culture minister, Miki Zohar, has called for the citizenship of Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor to be revoked. He accused them of "treason against the state" for their documentary 'NAZA,' which exposes the Israeli intelligence service's acronym for expected civilian casualties in Gaza...
summary.zh: 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和蕾切尔·索尔的公民身份。他指责他们制作的纪录片《NAZA》犯有“叛国罪”，该片揭露了以色列情报部门用于表示加沙空袭中预期平民伤亡的缩略语。这部电影强调了以色列军事行动对平民造成的毁灭性影响。

body.en: Miki Zohar accuses Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor of ‘treason against the state’ ‘They know the house they are bombing is full of children’: NAZA’s directors on their devastating film about Israeli intelligence Israel’s culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli directors of NAZA , a documentary about the country’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship, accusing them of “treason against the state”. NAZA, which was produced by the Guardian, is named for an acronym used by Israel’s intelligence service to indicate how many civilians it expects to die in an airstrike on Gaza. Continue reading...
body.zh: 米基·佐哈尔指责奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔“背叛国家”“他们知道他们轰炸的房子里都是孩子”：NAZA 的导演在拍摄有关以色列情报的毁灭性电影时以色列文化部长呼吁剥夺奥斯卡获奖导演 NAZA 的以色列国籍，这是一部关于该国在加沙大规模屠杀平民的纪录片，指责他们“背叛国家”。 NAZA 由《卫报》制作，以以色列情报部门使用的缩写词命名，用于表示预计在加沙空袭中将有多少平民死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story presents a stark conflict between artistic expression and state power. When a government official threatens to revoke citizenship for a film that documents civilian suffering, it raises questions about accountability and the role of art in confronting difficult truths. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness" and protect...
reflection.zh: 这个故事呈现了艺术表达与国家权力之间尖锐的冲突。当一位政府官员威胁要取消一部记录平民苦难的电影制作人的公民身份时，就引发了关于问责制和艺术在面对艰难真相中的作用的问题。耶利米书 22:3 呼吁领导人“施行公平和公义”，保护弱者，这是一个可以衡量此类行为的标准。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.zh: “你到底相信谁？”：成为故事一部分的真实犯罪迷

A man and a woman were murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly fell on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family...
summary.zh: 在HBO引人入胜的新纪录片系列《一个杀人故事》中，一对热心的夫妇坚信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。2002年的一天晚上，一男一女在堪萨斯州托皮卡家中被谋杀。嫌疑很快落在了受害男子的前妻 Dana Chandler...

body.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that woman accused of murder is innocent A man and a woman are murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly falls on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family and forensic evidence painting her as the jealous type. But the county prosecutor at the time declines to pursue charges in large part because nothing places Chandler at the scene of the crime. It’s only after a politically motivated prosecutor is appointed and CBS’s 48 Hours airs a 2009 report rehashing the case that Chandler is arrested on two counts of premeditated first-degree murder in 2011 and condemned to consecutive life sentences the following year. No doubt: the story is hot copy. And more than likely, Chandler’s conviction marks the conclusion if a husband-and-wife team of true crime enthusiasts hadn’t become convinced that the real killer was still walking free. “There’s a lot of questions that remain,” says film-maker Matthew Galkin. “But when you start to unpack the crime itself, there’s a lot of hoops to jump through and a very high bar to clear in order for her to have pulled this off.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 HBO 扣人心弦的新纪录片《杀手故事》中，一对斗志昂扬的夫妇确信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。 2002 年，一名男子和一名女子在黑暗的掩护下，在堪萨斯州托皮卡的卧室里被冷血谋杀。嫌疑人很快就落到了该男子的前妻达纳·钱德勒的身上，家人和法医证据都将她描绘成嫉妒型的人。但当时的县检察官拒绝提出指控，很大程度上是因为没有任何证据显示钱德勒在犯罪现场。直到任命了一位出于政治动机的检察官，并且哥伦比亚广播公司的 48 小时频道播出了 2009 年的报道，重述了此案之后，钱德勒才于 2011 年因两项预谋一级谋杀罪被捕，并在次年被连续判处无期徒刑。毫无疑问：这个故事是热门副本。如果一对真正的犯罪爱好者组成的夫妻团队没有相信真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外，那么钱德勒的定罪很可能标志着一个结论。 “还有很多问题没有解决，”电影制片人马修·加尔金说。 “但是，当你开始揭开犯罪本身的真相时，为了让她成功完成这件事，有很多障碍需要跨越，还有很高的门槛需要克服。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary series delves into the complexities of true crime, where a couple's conviction of innocence challenges the initial accusations. It reminds us of the importance of seeking truth and not settling for the first or loudest narrative. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, stating that 'The first person to speak in a lawsuit seems right, until someone...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片系列深入探讨了真实犯罪的复杂性，其中一对夫妇坚信某女子无辜，这挑战了最初的指控。它提醒我们寻求真相的重要性，不要满足于第一个或最响亮的声音。箴言18:17对此有所阐述，‘在讼事上先开口的，似乎都有理；但邻 Comes，就审问他。’

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Musk review – epic study of the world’s richest and most banal man

Ashley St Clair, a former conservative influencer and Musk's ex-girlfriend, is featured as an 'expert witness' in this four-hour study of the South...

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective incel id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，她是一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，也是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜线婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人的长达四个小时的史诗般的研究中，她是一位引人入胜的专家证人：出生于南非的亿万富翁，是一个过于自大、脾气暴躁的亿万富豪、冒牌的梦想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX火箭飞船、民族国家军事能力越来越依赖的星链卫星、塑造了数十亿集体非自愿群体的X（以前的推特）和每天都有庞大服务器群的GrokAI吞噬海洋宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

The narrative describes him as an 'ersatz visionary,' suggesting a disconnect between his ambition and true wisdom. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess sought to reach the heavens,...

body.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film takes the less-travelled path in charting the daily life of a pair of Czech twins a long way off conventional routes themselves. František and Ondřej Klišík are slowly going mad – or maybe closing in on enlightenment – in a cabin in the Šumava mountains and, extrapolating a short story about the brothers by Aleš Palán, director Miro Remo succumbs productively to the prevailing cabin fever – not only egging these longbeards on in their squabbling and loopy philosophising, but pitching in with his own fabulism and surrealism. Closing on 60, “Franta” and “Ondra” still farm their smallholding with the help of Nandy, a mutinous bull ill-chosen as a draught animal. In their downtime, they booze, banter and bicker, lament their lack of prospects with the fairer sex, and blow off steam in epic arm-wrestling bouts. Despite an arm lost to a sawmill accident, it’s Franta who’s usually the victor; he is also possessed by a quixotic streak absent in his bluff sibling. Letting loose streams of poetry into the air like bunting, wishing “joy to all conscious beings”, he is also constructing his own Da Vinci-style perpetual flying machine. “Your aversion to my perpetuum is a little annoying,” he informs the exasperated Ondra. body.zh: 在这部超现实的纪录片中，导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找充满堂吉诃德式智慧的两兄弟过着与世隔绝的生活。这部非凡的影片由一头被宰杀的公牛讲述，采取了一条人迹罕至的道路，描绘了一对捷克双胞胎的日常生活，远离传统路线。弗兰蒂谢克和昂德热·克利希克在苏马瓦山的一间小屋里慢慢发疯——或者可能接近启蒙，导演米罗·雷莫根据阿莱什·帕兰写的关于兄弟俩的短篇小说，有效地屈服于盛行的小屋热——不仅怂恿这些长胡子的人争吵和疯狂的哲学思考，还用自己的寓言和超现实主义。截至 60 日，“Franta”和“Ondra”仍在南迪（Nandy）的帮助下耕种他们的小农场，南迪是一头叛变的公牛，被错误地选为役畜。在闲暇时间，她们会喝酒、开玩笑、争吵，哀叹自己与异性交往的前景不佳，并在史诗般的扳手腕比赛中发泄情绪。尽管弗兰塔在锯木厂事故中失去了一条手臂，但通常胜利者都是弗兰塔。他还具有他那直率的兄弟所没有的不切实际的性格。他像彩旗一样将诗意的溪流抛向空中，祝愿“所有有意识的生物都快乐”，他也在建造自己的达芬奇式永久飞行器。 “你对我的永恒的厌恶有点烦人，”他告诉愤怒的昂德拉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary explores the fine line between profound isolation and spiritual insight, as two brothers grapple with their existence in the Czech wilderness. The film invites contemplation on what it means to seek wisdom, even when that path leads to the fringes of sanity. It reminds us that the search for meaning can be a deeply personal and sometimes...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了深刻的孤立与精神洞见之间的界限，讲述了两兄弟在捷克荒野中挣扎求生的故事。这部电影引人深思，探讨了寻求智慧的意义，即使这条道路会将人引向疯狂的边缘。它提醒我们，对意义的追寻可能是一段极其个人化且有时艰辛的旅程，触及了伴随如此深刻内省而来的破碎心灵。
